item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 07/Feb/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will strengthen in the next couple of days, it will be windy over the coast of southern China. The weather will be cold in the morning and at night over the inland areas. A band of clouds will cover the region early next week. With the monsoon moderating slightly, temperatures will rise over southern China midweek next week. A fresh easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of next week.
